entries.title: Glass Dropdown Position Fix
items: Fixed glass dropdown menus opening offset from their select field on pages with transformed, filtered, or glass-effect containers.
Dropdown menus are now rendered directly at the document root and positioned from the visible trigger rectangle.
Kept viewport clamping, above/below placement, keyboard navigation, and readable glass styling intact.

entries.title: Spotify Background Playback Recovery
items: Improved the persistent Spotify player when the Lunar browser tab becomes hidden and visible again.
The player now remembers whether playback was active and attempts to resume it when the tab returns to the foreground.
Playback position continues to be saved through Spotify iFrame playback updates so the current position can be restored after navigation or reload.

entries.title: Glass Dropdown System
items: Replaced native-looking select menus across Lunar pages with a consistent glass dropdown interface.
Dropdown options now use high-contrast text, readable hover and selected states, and a blurred glass panel instead of hard-to-read native lists.
Added automatic positioning so menus stay inside the viewport and open above the field when there is not enough room below it.
Added keyboard navigation, Escape-to-close, scrolling, dynamic option updates, and form-compatible native select synchronization.

entries.title: Automatic Deployment Updates
items: Added deployment-version detection for Lunar tabs that are already open when a new deployment goes live.
Lunar now checks the current deployment in the background and automatically refreshes the same page when a newer deployment is detected.
The refresh keeps the same route, query, and hash so users are transferred to the updated site without manually reopening Lunar.
Added cache-busting and no-cache handling to prevent an old version check from being reused.

entries.title: Spotify Persistent Player & Queue
items: Added a persistent Spotify mini-player that follows you across Lunar pages until you press X.
Improved the drag behavior and saved the player's screen position so it stays where you left it.
Added Spotify iFrame API playback tracking so the current song position is saved and restored when returning to Lunar.
Added automatic next-song playback for songs started from a Lunar playlist queue.
Restored the browser-window popout using a dedicated Spotify player page while keeping the normal URL bar and window controls.
Connected Spotify playlist song controls to the persistent player instead of the old page-only player.

entries.title: Spotify Playlist Song View
items: Clicking a Lunar playlist now opens the songs saved inside it.
Added individual Play controls for playlist songs.
Added per-song remove controls while keeping the existing Lunar playlist system.

entries.title: Automatic Home Member Counters
items: Removed manual member-counter editing from the home page.
Online, offline, and total member counts now come directly from the server and refresh automatically.
Removed the manual reset/edit behavior so the counters remain read-only.

entries.title: Friends DM Avatar Fix
items: Improved avatar loading for Friends direct-message messages.
Added fallback avatar lookup and observation for newly rendered DM messages.
Kept the existing Friends profile and message layout intact.

entries.title: Interface Motion & Effects Controls
items: Expanded the interface appearance controls for animations and visual effects.
Turning both animations and visual effects off now provides a much lighter interface for lower-end devices.
Updated motion handling so page transitions and visual effects respect the selected settings.
